<script type="text/javascript">
"use strict";
var relayId = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);

// %%%%%%%%% launch options %%%%%%%%%%%%

window.eaglercraftXOpts = {
	container: "game_frame",
	worldsDB: "worlds",
	relays: [
		{ addr: "wss://relay.deev.is/", comment: "lax1dude relay #1", primary: relayId == 0 },
		{ addr: "wss://relay.lax1dude.net/", comment: "lax1dude relay #2", primary: relayId == 1 },
		{ addr: "wss://relay.shhnowisnottheti.me/", comment: "ayunami relay #1", primary: relayId == 2 }
	]
};

// %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

</script>
<script type="text/javascript">
"use strict";
if(typeof window !== "undefined") window.eaglercraftXClientScriptElement = document.currentScript;
${classes_js}
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">
"use strict";
(function(){
	window.eaglercraftXOpts.assetsURI = ${assets_epk};

	var launchInterval = -1;
	var launchCounter = 1;
	var launchCountdownNumberElement = null;
	var launchCountdownProgressElement = null;
	var launchSkipCountdown = false;

	var launchTick = function() {
		launchCountdownNumberElement.innerText = "" + Math.floor(6.0 - launchCounter * 0.06);
		launchCountdownProgressElement.style.width = "" + launchCounter + "%";
		if(++launchCounter > 100 || launchSkipCountdown) {
			clearInterval(launchInterval);
			setTimeout(function() { document.body.removeChild(document.getElementById("launch_countdown_screen")); document.body.style.backgroundColor = "black"; main(); }, 50);
		}
	};

	window.addEventListener("load", function() {
		launchCountdownNumberElement = document.getElementById("launchCountdownNumber");
		launchCountdownProgressElement = document.getElementById("launchCountdownProgress");
		launchInterval = setInterval(launchTick, 50);
		document.getElementById("skipCountdown").addEventListener("click", function() {
			launchSkipCountdown = true;
		});
	});
})();
</script>
<link type="image/png" rel="shortcut icon" href="data:image/png;base64," />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ===== TREASURE CLIENT overlay — scoped under #tc-root, never touches the game canvas ===== */
#tc-root {
  --tc-gui: 0.80;
  --tc-fast: 140ms; --tc-med: 320ms;
  --tc-ease: cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1);
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483000;
  pointer-events: none;
  font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
#tc-root[data-theme="normal"] {
  --a-hi:#fff3c4; --a-1:#ffd76b; --a-2:#d4a537; --a-3:#8a5a20;
  --txt:#f6ecd2; --dim:#c9b183;
  --panel:rgba(28,19,5,0.94); --panel2:rgba(40,28,10,0.94);
  --bord:rgba(255,214,120,0.24); --glow:rgba(255,199,80,0.38);
  --bg0:#0f0a05;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(60,42,16,0.78); --tc-card-bord:rgba(255,214,120,0.40); --tc-card-glow:rgba(255,199,80,0.28);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="deep"] {
  --a-hi:#d6f7ff; --a-1:#7fe9ff; --a-2:#2ec4f1; --a-3:#145a7d;
  --txt:#dff6ff; --dim:#8fb9cc;
  --panel:rgba(3,16,26,0.90); --panel2:rgba(8,33,51,0.94);
  --bord:rgba(120,220,255,0.24); --glow:rgba(90,210,255,0.38);
  --bg0:#030f18;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(14,52,74,0.78); --tc-card-bord:rgba(120,220,255,0.40); --tc-card-glow:rgba(90,210,255,0.28);
}
#tc-root *, #tc-root *::before, #tc-root *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; }

/* ---------- HUD ---------- */
#tc-hud { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-hidden { display: none !important; }
#tc-crosshair {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 22px; height: 22px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 50% 0/2px 8px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 50% 100%/2px 8px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 0 50%/8px 2px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 100% 50%/8px 2px no-repeat;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px var(--glow));
}
#tc-crosshair.dot { background: var(--a-1); width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; }
#tc-crosshair.tshape { background:
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 50% 100%/2px 10px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 0 50%/9px 2px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 100% 50%/9px 2px no-repeat; }

/* mode-switch loading screen */
#tc-mode-loader { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483020; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: auto; opacity: 1; transition: opacity .3s ease;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(10,14,20,0.92), rgba(4,6,10,0.97)); font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; }
#tc-mode-loader.tc-ml-out { opacity: 0; }
#tc-mode-loader.tc-ml-deep { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(6,26,38,0.94), rgba(2,10,16,0.98)); }
.tc-ml-card { text-align: center; padding: 30px 40px; min-width: 340px; }
.tc-ml-title { font: 700 30px 'Cinzel', serif; letter-spacing: .18em;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe9a8,#d4a537); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-ml-deep .tc-ml-title { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#bff0ff,#2ec4f1); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-ml-sub { margin-top: 6px; font: 500 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #9fb0c0; letter-spacing: .05em; }
.tc-ml-bar { margin: 22px auto 12px; width: 300px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
.tc-ml-fill { height: 100%; width: 0%; border-radius: 999px; transition: width .34s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,#d4a537,#ffe9a8); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,215,107,0.5); }
.tc-ml-deep .tc-ml-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg,#2ec4f1,#bff0ff); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(46,196,241,0.5); }
.tc-ml-step { font: 500 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #cfe0ee; min-height: 18px; letter-spacing: .03em; }

/* hide all in-game HUD overlays on the main menu / when not in a world */
#tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-keystrokes, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-cps, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-fps,
#tc-root.tc-nogame .tc-hud-box, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-potions, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-fpsgraph,
#tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-perfmon { display: none !important; }

#tc-keystrokes {
  position: absolute; bottom: 66px; left: 18px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; align-items: center;
}
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-keystrokes { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-cps, #tc-root.hud-right #tc-fps { left: auto; right: 18px; }
.tc-ks-row { display: flex; gap: 5px; justify-content: center; }
.tc-ks-row span {
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 7px;
  font: 600 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--dim); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord);
  transition: all var(--tc-fast);
}
.tc-ks-row span.tc-wide { width: 52px; font-size: 11px; }
.tc-ks-row span.tc-space { width: 111px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
.tc-ks-row span.down { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--glow); }
#tc-cps, #tc-fps {
  position: absolute; left: 18px; font: 600 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--a-1); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord);
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 7px; white-space: nowrap;
}
#tc-cps { bottom: 34px; } #tc-fps { bottom: 6px; }

/* ---------- ClickGUI ---------- */
#tc-gui {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.42); backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease);
}
#tc-gui.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
#tc-gui-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 0; }
#tc-gui-panel {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  width: min(860px, 94vw); height: min(600px, 90vh); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  transform: scale(0.96) translateY(8px); transition: transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease);
  overflow: hidden; font-size: calc(1rem * var(--tc-gui));
}
#tc-gui.open #tc-gui-panel { transform: none; }

.tc-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 15px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bord);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-3) 20%, transparent), transparent); }
.tc-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .14em;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--a-hi) 10%, var(--a-1) 45%, var(--a-2) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; color: var(--a-1);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) drop-shadow(0 0 12px var(--glow)); }
.tc-title .tc-mark { -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--a-1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--glow)); }
.tc-title .tc-accent { -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-brandwrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-right: auto; }
.tc-logo-chest { height: 40px; width: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)); }
.tc-logo-word { height: 30px; width: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tc-brand-custom { font: 800 18px 'Outfit', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--a-1); filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); }
/* (Deep Sea mode toggle CSS removed — client is single-theme) */
.tc-close { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); background: transparent; color: var(--dim);
  font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-close:hover { color: var(--txt); border-color: #d4634a; transform: rotate(90deg); }

.tc-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 16px 22px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
.tc-cats { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; position: sticky; top: 0; }
.tc-cat { position: relative; font: 600 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; text-align: left; color: var(--dim); background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px 14px; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden;
  transition: color var(--tc-fast), background var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast), padding-left var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-cat::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--a-2);
  transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: center; transition: transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-cat:hover { color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2); padding-left: 17px; }
.tc-cat:hover::before { transform: scaleY(0.5); }
.tc-cat.active { color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2); border-color: var(--bord); }
.tc-cat.active::before { transform: scaleY(0.7); }
.tc-panel { display: none; }
.tc-panel.active { display: block; animation: tcFade var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-view { position:relative; width:100%; font:600 13px 'Outfit',sans-serif; text-align:left; color:var(--dim); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; padding:11px 14px; cursor:pointer; transition:all var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-view:hover { color:var(--txt); background:var(--panel2); }
.tc-view.active { color:var(--txt); background:var(--panel2); border-color:var(--bord); }
#tc-catbar { display:flex; flex-direction:row; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin:0 2px 14px; }
#tc-catbar .tc-cat { text-align:center; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--bord); background:var(--panel2); }
#tc-catbar .tc-cat::before { display:none !important; }
#tc-catbar .tc-cat.active { background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); color:var(--bg0); border-color:transparent; }
#tc-body.tcv-modules .tc-panel[data-group="themes"] { display:none !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-themes .tc-panel { display:none !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-themes .tc-panel[data-group="themes"] { display:block !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-themes #tc-catbar { display:none !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-hud .tc-panels { display:none !important; }
.tc-body.searching #tc-catbar { display:none !important; }
@keyframes tcFade { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.tc-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 11px 8px; margin: 0 -4px; border-radius: 9px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 45%, transparent);
  transition: background var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.tc-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-3) 10%, transparent); }
.tc-lab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.tc-lab b { font: 600 13.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); }
.tc-lab i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-row .tc-sw, .tc-row select, .tc-row .tc-slider { margin-left: auto; }
.tc-pending { opacity: 0.6; }
.tc-note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tc-note.tc-dim { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; padding: 6px 4px; opacity: 0.75; }
.tc-note b { color: var(--txt); font-weight: 600; }
/* section divider + label */
.tc-sep { height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 60%, transparent); margin: 12px -4px; }
.tc-seclabel { font: 700 10.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--a-2); margin: 4px 4px 8px; }
/* compact buttons used inline in rows/config */
.tc-btn-sm { margin: 0 !important; padding: 9px 16px !important; }
.tc-btn-xs { margin: 0 !important; padding: 6px 14px !important; font-size: 11.5px !important; }
/* a static (always-open) config block, e.g. the Mod Menu keybind controls */
.tc-cfg.tc-cfg-static { max-height: none; opacity: 1; overflow: visible; padding: 2px 8px 8px; }
.tc-hint { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); font-style: italic; }

.tc-sw { width: 44px; height: 25px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: background var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), border-color var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tc-sw:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-2) 20%, transparent); }
.tc-sw i { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dim); transition: transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), background var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-sw.on { background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px -4px var(--glow); }
.tc-sw.on i { transform: translateX(19px); background: var(--bg0); }

/* per-mod settings: gear + expandable config panel */
.tc-mod { border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 45%, transparent); }
.tc-mod:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.tc-mod .tc-row { border-bottom: 0; }
.tc-gear { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--a-2); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-2) 14%, transparent); color: var(--a-1);
  font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; margin-left: auto; transition: color var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tc-gear + .tc-sw { margin-left: 10px; }
.tc-gear:hover { color: var(--a-1); border-color: var(--a-2); transform: rotate(60deg); }
.tc-gear.open { color: var(--bg0); background: var(--a-2); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-cfg { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: max-height var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), opacity var(--tc-med), padding var(--tc-med); padding: 0 8px; }
.tc-cfg.open { max-height: 360px; opacity: 1; padding: 4px 8px 12px; }
.tc-cfg-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-cfg-row > span { min-width: 74px; }
.tc-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; }
.tc-seg button { font: 600 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; transition: color var(--tc-fast), background var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-seg button.on { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); }
.tc-seg.tc-seg-sm { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; max-width: 210px; }
.tc-seg.tc-seg-sm button { padding: 4px 9px; font-size: 11px; }

.tc-slider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.tc-slider input[type="range"] { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 130px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel2); }
.tc-slider input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a-1); cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--bg0); }
.tc-slider input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a-1); cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--bg0); }
.tc-val { font: 600 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1); min-width: 26px; text-align: right; }
.tc-row select { font: 500 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 11px; cursor: pointer; outline: none; }

.tc-perf { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); background: linear-gradient(120deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-2) 16%, transparent), transparent); }
.tc-perf-fps { font: 600 26px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1); line-height: 1; }
.tc-perf-txt b { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--txt); }
.tc-perf-txt i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-badge { margin-left: auto; font: 600 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--a-1); border: 1px solid var(--a-2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-perf-note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--a-1); min-height: 15px; margin: 4px 2px 8px; }

/* section label (used across Interface / Performance panels) */
.tc-seclabel { font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tc-apply { margin-top: 14px; width: 100%; font: 600 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -10px var(--glow); transition: transform var(--tc-fast), filter var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-apply:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px var(--glow); }
.tc-apply:active { transform: translateY(0); }

.tc-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bord); }
.tc-foot-label { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-keybind { font: 600 12.5px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1); background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 13px; cursor: pointer; min-width: 92px; text-align: center; transition: all var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-keybind:hover { border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-keybind.listening { color: var(--bg0); background: var(--a-1); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-foot-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-spacer { margin-left: auto; }
.tc-done { font: 600 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 22px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -10px var(--glow); transition: transform var(--tc-fast), filter var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-done:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px var(--glow); }
.tc-done:active { transform: translateY(0); }

/* ---------- search ---------- */

/* 1.1: mod settings sub-page (opened by the gear / right-click) */
.tc-subpage { display: none; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px 20px 22px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
#tc-gui-panel.tc-showsub .tc-body { display: none; }
#tc-gui-panel.tc-showsub .tc-subpage { display: flex; }
.tc-subpage-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.tc-subback { font: 600 14px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--a-1); background: var(--tc-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--tc-card-bord); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px -2px var(--tc-card-glow); transition: border-color var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-med); }
.tc-subback:hover { border-color: var(--a-2); box-shadow: 0 0 16px -1px var(--tc-card-glow); }
.tc-subpage-title { font: 700 22px 'Cinzel', serif; color: var(--a-1); letter-spacing: 1px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px var(--glow)); }
.tc-subpage-body { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; }
.tc-subpage-body .tc-cfg { max-height: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; overflow: visible !important;
  padding: 0 !important; display: block; }
.tc-subpage-body .tc-cfg-row { padding: 12px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 40%, transparent); }
/* 1.1: mods laid out as cards in a responsive grid (wide, not tall) */
.tc-panel.active { display: block; }
.tc-panels { width: 100%; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.tc-panel { columns: 2; column-gap: 24px; }
.tc-mod { border: 1px solid var(--tc-card-bord); border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--tc-card-bg); padding: 6px 14px; margin: 0 0 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px -2px var(--tc-card-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,235,170,0.06);
  break-inside: avoid; -webkit-column-break-inside: avoid;
  transition: box-shadow var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), border-color var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-mod:hover { border-color: var(--a-2); box-shadow: 0 0 16px -1px var(--tc-card-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,235,170,0.10); }
.tc-mod .tc-row { padding: 10px 2px; }
.tc-mod .tc-cfg { padding-left: 2px; padding-right: 2px; }
.tc-seclabel { column-span: all; -webkit-column-span: all; }

.tc-search-wrap { position: relative; margin: 2px 2px 12px; }
.tc-search { width: 100%; font: 500 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 12px 9px 32px; outline: none; transition: border-color var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-search:focus { border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-search-ic { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-search-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); padding: 20px 8px; text-align: center; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-panel { display: none; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-panel.tc-search-hit { display: block; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-cats { display: none; }
/* search mode: sidebar is hidden, so collapse its column and give panels full width */
.tc-body.searching { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-panels { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
[data-searchmiss] { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- HUD data readouts (coords / direction / ping / armor / potions / held item) ---------- */
.tc-hud-box { position: absolute; font: 600 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1);
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
#tc-coords { top: 18px; left: 18px; }
#tc-direction { top: 18px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; }
#tc-ping { top: 18px; right: 18px; }
#tc-armor { top: 56px; right: 18px; display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; }
.tc-armor-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-width: 30px; }
.tc-armor-slot b { font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); font-weight: 600; }
.tc-armor-slot i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; }
.tc-armor-slot i.low { color: #e0715a; }
#tc-potions { position: absolute; bottom: 130px; right: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; align-items: flex-end; }
.tc-potion-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; }
.tc-potion-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--glow); flex: 0 0 auto; }
#tc-helditem { bottom: 128px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; }
#tc-sprint { top: 56px; left: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-sprint { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-sneak { top: 84px; left: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-sneak { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-helditem { left: 50%; right: auto; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-coords { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-armor { right: auto; left: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-potions { right: auto; left: 18px; align-items: flex-start; }
#tc-fpsgraph { bottom: 18px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 6px; }
#tc-fpsgraph canvas { display: block; }
#tc-perfmon { top: 60px; left: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 108px; }
#tc-perfmon .tc-pm-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; }
#tc-perfmon .tc-pm-row span:last-child { color: var(--txt); }

/* ---------- HUD edit mode (drag to reposition) ---------- */
#tc-root.hud-editing .tc-hud-box, #tc-root.hud-editing #tc-keystrokes,
#tc-root.hud-editing #tc-cps, #tc-root.hud-editing #tc-fps, #tc-root.hud-editing #tc-potions {
  outline: 1px dashed var(--a-1); outline-offset: 3px; cursor: grab; pointer-events: auto; user-select: none;
}
#tc-root.hud-editing .tc-hidden { display: none !important; } /* keep disabled HUD elements hidden in edit mode */
#tc-root.hud-editing .tc-hud-drag-active { cursor: grabbing; outline-color: var(--a-hi); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow); }
/* dim the frozen game behind the HUD editor and swallow stray clicks (the in-game menu is open underneath to pause the world) */
#tc-root.hud-editing::before { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(6,8,16,0.55); pointer-events: auto; }
.tc-editbar { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 22px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 2147483001;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 9px 9px 9px 18px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); pointer-events: auto; }
.tc-editbar span { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); }
.tc-editbar button { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-editbar button:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }
.tc-editbar .tc-eb-reset { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--dim); border: 1px solid var(--bord); }
.tc-editbar .tc-eb-done { background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); color: var(--bg0); }

/* ---------- keybind manager ---------- */
.tc-kb-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 8px; }
.tc-kb-row .tc-lab { flex: 1; }
.tc-kb-warn { font-size: 11px; color: #e0715a; margin-top: 4px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #tc-root * { animation-duration: .001ms !important; transition-duration: .001ms !important; } }

/* ===== Themes tab (Frost + expandable theme system) ===== */
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] {
  --a-hi:#eaf7ff; --a-1:#bfe6ff; --a-2:#6fc3ec; --a-3:#2f6f9c;
  --txt:#eef7ff; --dim:#a9cadd;
  --panel:rgba(10,22,34,0.92); --panel2:rgba(16,34,52,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(150,210,245,0.26); --glow:rgba(130,200,255,0.42);
  --bg0:#07131f;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(18,44,66,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(150,210,245,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(130,200,255,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="tropical"] {
  --a-hi:#d9fff6; --a-1:#45e3c6; --a-2:#1fb6ba; --a-3:#0e6d78;
  --txt:#f3ecd6; --dim:#d8c38f;
  --panel:rgba(8,28,32,0.92); --panel2:rgba(12,40,46,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(120,230,215,0.26); --glow:rgba(70,220,200,0.42);
  --bg0:#05171a;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(14,52,56,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(120,230,215,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(70,220,200,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="terracotta"] {
  --a-hi:#ffcf9e; --a-1:#e8863a; --a-2:#c05f26; --a-3:#7a3d1d;
  --txt:#f6e6d4; --dim:#d8ad84;
  --panel:rgba(32,18,10,0.92); --panel2:rgba(46,26,14,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(232,150,80,0.26); --glow:rgba(226,130,60,0.42);
  --bg0:#1a0e06;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(60,32,16,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(232,150,80,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(226,130,60,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="forest"] {
  --a-hi:#d6f8c2; --a-1:#6fcb5b; --a-2:#3d9a3f; --a-3:#215a27;
  --txt:#eaf6dd; --dim:#aecb96;
  --panel:rgba(12,28,14,0.92); --panel2:rgba(16,40,20,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(140,220,120,0.26); --glow:rgba(110,210,90,0.42);
  --bg0:#07160a;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(20,52,24,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(140,220,120,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(110,210,90,0.30);
}
.tc-te-label { font: 600 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 7px; }
.tc-te-bgrow { margin-bottom: 13px; }
.tc-te-bgs { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tc-bgopt { width: 96px; height: 54px; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--bord); background-size: cover; background-position: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-bgopt:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-bgopt.sel { border-color: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--a-1); }
#tc-gui-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background-position: center; background-size: cover; background-repeat: no-repeat; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .45s var(--tc-ease); pointer-events: none; }
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] #tc-gui-img { opacity: 1; }
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] #tc-gui { background: rgba(6,16,28,0.34); }
#tc-gui-bg { z-index: 1; }
#tc-gui-panel { z-index: 2; }
.tc-titletext { -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-theme-hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); margin: 2px 2px 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tc-themes-head { margin: 0 2px 14px; }
.tc-themes-h1 { font: 700 15px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.tc-themes-sub { font: 500 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 3px; }
.tc-themes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(156px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.tc-theme { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; background: var(--panel2); aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; transition: transform var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-theme:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--a-2); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -14px var(--glow); }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-thumb { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-position: center; background-size: cover; }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-foot { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.80)); }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-name { font: 700 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-tag { margin-left: auto; font: 700 10px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-theme.selected { border-color: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--a-1), 0 10px 26px -14px var(--glow); }
.tc-theme.selected .tc-theme-tag { opacity: 1; }
.tc-title-editor { display: none; margin: 0 0 15px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel2); }
.tc-title-editor.open { display: block; animation: tcFade var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-head { font: 600 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); margin-bottom: 9px; }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-head b { color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-title-editor input { width: 100%; font: 500 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--bg0); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; outline: none; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tc-title-editor input:focus { border-color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-te-select { width: 100%; font: 500 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--bg0); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; outline: none; margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.tc-te-select:focus { border-color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tc-te-btns button { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-te-btns button:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); }
.tc-te-save { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-te-reset, .tc-te-cancel { color: var(--dim); background: transparent; }

    </style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0px;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background-color:white;" id="game_frame">
<div id="tc-root" data-theme="normal" aria-hidden="true">
  <!-- HUD layer (always-on, never captures input) -->
  <div id="tc-hud">
    <div id="tc-crosshair" class="tc-hidden"></div>
    <div id="tc-keystrokes" class="tc-hidden">
      <div class="tc-ks-row"><span data-key="KeyW">W</span></div>
      <div class="tc-ks-row"><span data-key="KeyA">A</span><span data-key="KeyS">S</span><span data-key="KeyD">D</span></div>
      <div class="tc-ks-row"><span data-key="MouseL" class="tc-wide">LMB</span><span data-key="MouseR" class="tc-wide">RMB</span></div>
      <div class="tc-ks-row"><span data-key="Space" class="tc-space">SPACE</span></div>
    </div>
    <div id="tc-cps" class="tc-hidden">0 CPS</div>
    <div id="tc-fps" class="tc-hidden">0 FPS</div>
    <div id="tc-coords" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden">— , — , —</div>
    <div id="tc-direction" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden">—</div>
    <div id="tc-ping" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden">— ms</div>
    <div id="tc-armor" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden"></div>
    <div id="tc-potions" class="tc-hidden"></div>
    <div id="tc-helditem" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden">—</div>
    <div id="tc-sprint" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden">Sprint [OFF]</div>
    <div id="tc-sneak" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden">Sneak [OFF]</div>
    <div id="tc-fpsgraph" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden"><canvas id="tc-fpsgraph-cv" width="140" height="34"></canvas></div>
    <div id="tc-perfmon" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tc-editbar tc-hidden" id="tc-editbar">
    <span>Drag HUD elements to reposition</span>
    <button class="tc-eb-reset" id="tc-eb-reset">Reset Positions</button>
    <button class="tc-eb-done" id="tc-eb-done">Done</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ClickGUI (captures input only while open) -->
  <div id="tc-gui">
    <div id="tc-gui-img"></div>
    <canvas id="tc-gui-bg"></canvas>
    <div id="tc-gui-panel">
      <div class="tc-head">
        <div class="tc-brandwrap"><img class="tc-logo-chest" alt="" draggable="false"><img class="tc-logo-word" alt="Treasure Client" draggable="false"><span class="tc-brand-custom" style="display:none"></span></div>
        <button class="tc-close" id="tc-close" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="tc-search-wrap">
        <span class="tc-search-ic">🔍</span>
        <input class="tc-search" id="tc-search" type="text" placeholder="Search mods, settings, categories…" autocomplete="off">
      </div>
      <div class="tc-subpage" id="tc-subpage">
        <div class="tc-subpage-head">
          <button class="tc-subback" id="tc-subback">‹ Back</button>
          <div class="tc-subpage-title" id="tc-subpage-title">Settings</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tc-subpage-body" id="tc-subpage-body"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tc-body" id="tc-body">
        <div class="tc-cats" id="tc-cats">
          <button class="tc-view active" data-view="modules">Modules</button>
          <button class="tc-view" data-view="hud">HUD Editor</button>
          <button class="tc-view" data-view="themes">Themes</button>
        </div>
        <div class="tc-panels">
          <div class="tc-catbar" id="tc-catbar">
            <button class="tc-cat active" data-cat="all">All</button>
            <button class="tc-cat" data-cat="hud">HUD</button>
            <button class="tc-cat" data-cat="render">Render</button>
            <button class="tc-cat" data-cat="perf">Performance</button>
            <button class="tc-cat" data-cat="misc">Misc</button>
          </div>
          <!-- hud -->
          <div class="tc-panel active" data-panel="hud" data-group="hud">
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Coordinates</b><i>Real X / Y / Z position</i></div><button class="tc-gear" data-gear="coordcfg" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="coords"><i></i></div></div>
              <div class="tc-cfg" data-cfg="coordcfg">
                <div class="tc-cfg-row"><span>Precision</span>
                  <div class="tc-seg" data-seg="coordPrecision">
                    <button data-val="0">Whole</button>
                    <button data-val="1">1 decimal</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Direction</b><i>Compass heading</i></div><button class="tc-gear" data-gear="dircfg" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="direction"><i></i></div></div>
              <div class="tc-cfg" data-cfg="dircfg">
                <div class="tc-cfg-row"><span>Mode</span>
                  <div class="tc-seg" data-seg="dirMode">
                    <button data-val="cardinal">Cardinal</button>
                    <button data-val="detailed">Detailed</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Saturation Display</b><i>Gold outlines on the food bar show hidden saturation</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="satDisplay"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Armor Status</b><i>Equipped armor + durability</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="armorStatus"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Potion Effects</b><i>Active effects, level &amp; duration</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="potionEffects"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Held Item</b><i>Name, count &amp; durability</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="heldItem"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Keystrokes</b><i>On-screen WASD + mouse</i></div><button class="tc-gear" data-gear="kscfg" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="keystrokes"><i></i></div></div>
              <div class="tc-cfg" data-cfg="kscfg">
                <div class="tc-cfg-row"><span>Show</span>
                  <div class="tc-seg" data-seg="ksShowMouse">
                    <button data-val="1">Mouse + Space</button>
                    <button data-val="0">WASD only</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>CPS Counter</b><i>Live clicks per second</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="cps"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">

            <div class="tc-kb-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Treasure Settings</b><i>Open / close this menu</i></div><button class="tc-keybind tc-kb-required" data-bindkey="menu">Right Shift</button></div>
            <div class="tc-kb-warn" id="tc-kb-warn"></div>
            <div class="tc-cfg-row" style="margin-top:10px"><span>Reset Treasure Settings key</span><button class="tc-apply tc-btn-xs" id="tc-kb-default">Reset to Right Shift</button></div>
            <div class="tc-sep"></div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Menu Animations</b><i>Smooth open / close &amp; hover transitions</i></div><div class="tc-sw on" data-mod="guiAnim"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <!-- themes -->
          <div class="tc-panel" data-panel="themes" data-group="themes">
            <div class="tc-themes-head"><div class="tc-themes-h1">Appearance</div><div class="tc-themes-sub">Left-click to apply · right-click for background &amp; title</div></div>
            <div class="tc-title-editor" id="tc-title-editor">
              <div class="tc-te-head">Theme settings — <b id="tc-te-theme">Frost</b></div>
              <div class="tc-te-bgrow" id="tc-te-bgrow" style="display:none">
                <div class="tc-te-label">Background</div>
                <div class="tc-te-bgs" id="tc-te-bgs"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="tc-te-label">Client title</div>
              <input id="tc-te-input" type="text" maxlength="40" placeholder="Treasure Client" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
              <div class="tc-te-label">Title font <i style="font-weight:400;opacity:.7">(applies to a custom title)</i></div>
              <select id="tc-te-font" class="tc-te-select">
                <option value="'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif">Outfit</option>
                <option value="'Cinzel', 'Times New Roman', serif">Cinzel</option>
                <option value="'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace">Monospace</option>
                <option value="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif">Serif</option>
                <option value="Impact, Haettenschweiler, sans-serif">Impact</option>
                <option value="'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif">Trebuchet</option>
              </select>
              <div class="tc-te-btns">
                <button class="tc-te-save" id="tc-te-save">Save</button>
                <button class="tc-te-reset" id="tc-te-reset">Reset to default</button>
                <button class="tc-te-cancel" id="tc-te-cancel">Cancel</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-themes" id="tc-themes"></div>
          </div>
          <!-- profile / skins removed -->
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tc-foot">
        <span class="tc-foot-label">Open menu with</span>
        <button class="tc-keybind" data-bindkey="menu">Right Shift</button>
        <span class="tc-foot-hint">Rebindable · manage all keys in Other Mods ▸ Keybind Manager</span>
        <span class="tc-spacer"></span>
        <button class="tc-done" id="tc-done">Done</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
window.__tcRefocusGame = function(){ try { var gf = document.getElementById("game_frame"); var cv = gf && gf.querySelector("canvas"); (cv||gf) && (cv||gf).focus && (cv||gf).focus(); } catch(e){} };
/* ================= TREASURE CLIENT overlay logic =================
   Fully self-contained and defensive: any failure in here is caught and
   logged, and can never prevent the game itself from booting. The game
   boots normally (engine's own main()); this only adds a HUD + ClickGUI
   layer on top of the canvas.

   CRITICAL: the engine, at boot, does `getElementById("game_frame")` (the
   <body>) and REMOVES ALL of its children before inserting its canvas. Our
   overlay starts life inside <body>, so it would get wiped. To survive, we
   relocate #tc-root to be a direct child of <html> (documentElement), which
   the engine never clears, and we keep a watchdog that re-attaches it if it
   ever disappears. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // Treasure Client: the WASM bundler rebuilds the page body and drops static
  // markup, so build #tc-root from an embedded string if it isn't already there.
  // Treasure Client: the WASM bundler strips the <head> <style>, so inject the
  // overlay CSS from JS too (same reason we build the markup from a string).
  var TC_ROOT_CSS = `
/* ===== TREASURE CLIENT overlay — scoped under #tc-root, never touches the game canvas ===== */
#tc-root {
  --tc-gui: 0.80;
  --tc-fast: 140ms; --tc-med: 320ms;
  --tc-ease: cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1);
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483000;
  pointer-events: none;
  font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
#tc-root[data-theme="normal"] {
  --a-hi:#fff3c4; --a-1:#ffd76b; --a-2:#d4a537; --a-3:#8a5a20;
  --txt:#f6ecd2; --dim:#c9b183;
  --panel:rgba(28,19,5,0.94); --panel2:rgba(40,28,10,0.94);
  --bord:rgba(255,214,120,0.24); --glow:rgba(255,199,80,0.38);
  --bg0:#0f0a05;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(60,42,16,0.78); --tc-card-bord:rgba(255,214,120,0.40); --tc-card-glow:rgba(255,199,80,0.28);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="deep"] {
  --a-hi:#d6f7ff; --a-1:#7fe9ff; --a-2:#2ec4f1; --a-3:#145a7d;
  --txt:#dff6ff; --dim:#8fb9cc;
  --panel:rgba(3,16,26,0.90); --panel2:rgba(8,33,51,0.94);
  --bord:rgba(120,220,255,0.24); --glow:rgba(90,210,255,0.38);
  --bg0:#030f18;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(14,52,74,0.78); --tc-card-bord:rgba(120,220,255,0.40); --tc-card-glow:rgba(90,210,255,0.28);
}
#tc-root *, #tc-root *::before, #tc-root *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; }

/* ---------- HUD ---------- */
#tc-hud { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-hidden { display: none !important; }
#tc-crosshair {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 22px; height: 22px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 50% 0/2px 8px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 50% 100%/2px 8px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 0 50%/8px 2px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 100% 50%/8px 2px no-repeat;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px var(--glow));
}
#tc-crosshair.dot { background: var(--a-1); width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; }
#tc-crosshair.tshape { background:
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 50% 100%/2px 10px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 0 50%/9px 2px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(var(--a-1),var(--a-1)) 100% 50%/9px 2px no-repeat; }

/* mode-switch loading screen */
#tc-mode-loader { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483020; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: auto; opacity: 1; transition: opacity .3s ease;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(10,14,20,0.92), rgba(4,6,10,0.97)); font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; }
#tc-mode-loader.tc-ml-out { opacity: 0; }
#tc-mode-loader.tc-ml-deep { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(6,26,38,0.94), rgba(2,10,16,0.98)); }
.tc-ml-card { text-align: center; padding: 30px 40px; min-width: 340px; }
.tc-ml-title { font: 700 30px 'Cinzel', serif; letter-spacing: .18em;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe9a8,#d4a537); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-ml-deep .tc-ml-title { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#bff0ff,#2ec4f1); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-ml-sub { margin-top: 6px; font: 500 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #9fb0c0; letter-spacing: .05em; }
.tc-ml-bar { margin: 22px auto 12px; width: 300px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
.tc-ml-fill { height: 100%; width: 0%; border-radius: 999px; transition: width .34s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,#d4a537,#ffe9a8); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,215,107,0.5); }
.tc-ml-deep .tc-ml-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg,#2ec4f1,#bff0ff); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(46,196,241,0.5); }
.tc-ml-step { font: 500 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #cfe0ee; min-height: 18px; letter-spacing: .03em; }

/* hide all in-game HUD overlays on the main menu / when not in a world */
#tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-keystrokes, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-cps, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-fps,
#tc-root.tc-nogame .tc-hud-box, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-potions, #tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-fpsgraph,
#tc-root.tc-nogame #tc-perfmon { display: none !important; }

#tc-keystrokes {
  position: absolute; bottom: 66px; left: 18px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; align-items: center;
}
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-keystrokes { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-cps, #tc-root.hud-right #tc-fps { left: auto; right: 18px; }
.tc-ks-row { display: flex; gap: 5px; justify-content: center; }
.tc-ks-row span {
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 7px;
  font: 600 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--dim); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord);
  transition: all var(--tc-fast);
}
.tc-ks-row span.tc-wide { width: 52px; font-size: 11px; }
.tc-ks-row span.tc-space { width: 111px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
.tc-ks-row span.down { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--glow); }
#tc-cps, #tc-fps {
  position: absolute; left: 18px; font: 600 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--a-1); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord);
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 7px; white-space: nowrap;
}
#tc-cps { bottom: 34px; } #tc-fps { bottom: 6px; }

/* ---------- ClickGUI ---------- */
#tc-gui {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.42); backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease);
}
#tc-gui.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
#tc-gui-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 0; }
#tc-gui-panel {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  width: min(860px, 94vw); height: min(600px, 90vh); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  transform: scale(0.96) translateY(8px); transition: transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease);
  overflow: hidden; font-size: calc(1rem * var(--tc-gui));
}
#tc-gui.open #tc-gui-panel { transform: none; }

.tc-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 15px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bord);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-3) 20%, transparent), transparent); }
.tc-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .14em;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--a-hi) 10%, var(--a-1) 45%, var(--a-2) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; color: var(--a-1);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) drop-shadow(0 0 12px var(--glow)); }
.tc-title .tc-mark { -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--a-1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--glow)); }
.tc-title .tc-accent { -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-brandwrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-right: auto; }
.tc-logo-chest { height: 40px; width: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)); }
.tc-logo-word { height: 30px; width: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tc-brand-custom { font: 800 18px 'Outfit', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--a-1); filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); }
/* (Deep Sea mode toggle CSS removed — client is single-theme) */
.tc-close { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); background: transparent; color: var(--dim);
  font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-close:hover { color: var(--txt); border-color: #d4634a; transform: rotate(90deg); }

.tc-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 16px 22px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
.tc-cats { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; position: sticky; top: 0; }
.tc-cat { position: relative; font: 600 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; text-align: left; color: var(--dim); background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px 14px; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden;
  transition: color var(--tc-fast), background var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast), padding-left var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-cat::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--a-2);
  transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: center; transition: transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-cat:hover { color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2); padding-left: 17px; }
.tc-cat:hover::before { transform: scaleY(0.5); }
.tc-cat.active { color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2); border-color: var(--bord); }
.tc-cat.active::before { transform: scaleY(0.7); }
.tc-panel { display: none; }
.tc-panel.active { display: block; animation: tcFade var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-view { position:relative; width:100%; font:600 13px 'Outfit',sans-serif; text-align:left; color:var(--dim); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; padding:11px 14px; cursor:pointer; transition:all var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-view:hover { color:var(--txt); background:var(--panel2); }
.tc-view.active { color:var(--txt); background:var(--panel2); border-color:var(--bord); }
#tc-catbar { display:flex; flex-direction:row; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin:0 2px 14px; }
#tc-catbar .tc-cat { text-align:center; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--bord); background:var(--panel2); }
#tc-catbar .tc-cat::before { display:none !important; }
#tc-catbar .tc-cat.active { background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); color:var(--bg0); border-color:transparent; }
#tc-body.tcv-modules .tc-panel[data-group="themes"] { display:none !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-themes .tc-panel { display:none !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-themes .tc-panel[data-group="themes"] { display:block !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-themes #tc-catbar { display:none !important; }
#tc-body.tcv-hud .tc-panels { display:none !important; }
.tc-body.searching #tc-catbar { display:none !important; }
@keyframes tcFade { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.tc-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 11px 8px; margin: 0 -4px; border-radius: 9px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 45%, transparent);
  transition: background var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.tc-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-3) 10%, transparent); }
.tc-lab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.tc-lab b { font: 600 13.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); }
.tc-lab i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-row .tc-sw, .tc-row select, .tc-row .tc-slider { margin-left: auto; }
.tc-pending { opacity: 0.6; }
.tc-note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tc-note.tc-dim { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; padding: 6px 4px; opacity: 0.75; }
.tc-note b { color: var(--txt); font-weight: 600; }
/* section divider + label */
.tc-sep { height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 60%, transparent); margin: 12px -4px; }
.tc-seclabel { font: 700 10.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--a-2); margin: 4px 4px 8px; }
/* compact buttons used inline in rows/config */
.tc-btn-sm { margin: 0 !important; padding: 9px 16px !important; }
.tc-btn-xs { margin: 0 !important; padding: 6px 14px !important; font-size: 11.5px !important; }
/* a static (always-open) config block, e.g. the Mod Menu keybind controls */
.tc-cfg.tc-cfg-static { max-height: none; opacity: 1; overflow: visible; padding: 2px 8px 8px; }
.tc-hint { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); font-style: italic; }

.tc-sw { width: 44px; height: 25px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: background var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), border-color var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tc-sw:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-2) 20%, transparent); }
.tc-sw i { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dim); transition: transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), background var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-sw.on { background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px -4px var(--glow); }
.tc-sw.on i { transform: translateX(19px); background: var(--bg0); }

/* per-mod settings: gear + expandable config panel */
.tc-mod { border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bord) 45%, transparent); }
.tc-mod:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.tc-mod .tc-row { border-bottom: 0; }
.tc-gear { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--a-2); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-2) 14%, transparent); color: var(--a-1);
  font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; margin-left: auto; transition: color var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tc-gear + .tc-sw { margin-left: 10px; }
.tc-gear:hover { color: var(--a-1); border-color: var(--a-2); transform: rotate(60deg); }
.tc-gear.open { color: var(--bg0); background: var(--a-2); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-cfg { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: max-height var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease), opacity var(--tc-med), padding var(--tc-med); padding: 0 8px; }
.tc-cfg.open { max-height: 360px; opacity: 1; padding: 4px 8px 12px; }
.tc-cfg-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-cfg-row > span { min-width: 74px; }
.tc-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; }
.tc-seg button { font: 600 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; transition: color var(--tc-fast), background var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-seg button.on { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); }
.tc-seg.tc-seg-sm { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; max-width: 210px; }
.tc-seg.tc-seg-sm button { padding: 4px 9px; font-size: 11px; }

.tc-slider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.tc-slider input[type="range"] { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 130px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel2); }
.tc-slider input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a-1); cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--bg0); }
.tc-slider input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a-1); cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--bg0); }
.tc-val { font: 600 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1); min-width: 26px; text-align: right; }
.tc-row select { font: 500 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 11px; cursor: pointer; outline: none; }

.tc-perf { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); background: linear-gradient(120deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--a-2) 16%, transparent), transparent); }
.tc-perf-fps { font: 600 26px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1); line-height: 1; }
.tc-perf-txt b { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--txt); }
.tc-perf-txt i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-badge { margin-left: auto; font: 600 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--a-1); border: 1px solid var(--a-2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-perf-note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--a-1); min-height: 15px; margin: 4px 2px 8px; }

/* section label (used across Interface / Performance panels) */
.tc-seclabel { font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tc-apply { margin-top: 14px; width: 100%; font: 600 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -10px var(--glow); transition: transform var(--tc-fast), filter var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-apply:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px var(--glow); }
.tc-apply:active { transform: translateY(0); }

.tc-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bord); }
.tc-foot-label { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-keybind { font: 600 12.5px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1); background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 13px; cursor: pointer; min-width: 92px; text-align: center; transition: all var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-keybind:hover { border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-keybind.listening { color: var(--bg0); background: var(--a-1); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-foot-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); }
.tc-spacer { margin-left: auto; }
.tc-done { font: 600 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 22px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -10px var(--glow); transition: transform var(--tc-fast), filter var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-done:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px var(--glow); }
.tc-done:active { transform: translateY(0); }

/* ---------- search ---------- */
.tc-search-wrap { position: relative; margin: 2px 2px 12px; }
.tc-search { width: 100%; font: 500 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 12px 9px 32px; outline: none; transition: border-color var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-search:focus { border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-search-ic { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-search-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); padding: 20px 8px; text-align: center; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-panel { display: none; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-panel.tc-search-hit { display: block; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-cats { display: none; }
/* search mode: sidebar is hidden, so collapse its column and give panels full width */
.tc-body.searching { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.tc-body.searching .tc-panels { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
[data-searchmiss] { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- HUD data readouts (coords / direction / ping / armor / potions / held item) ---------- */
.tc-hud-box { position: absolute; font: 600 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--a-1);
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
#tc-coords { top: 18px; left: 18px; }
#tc-direction { top: 18px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; }
#tc-ping { top: 18px; right: 18px; }
#tc-armor { top: 56px; right: 18px; display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; }
.tc-armor-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-width: 30px; }
.tc-armor-slot b { font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); font-weight: 600; }
.tc-armor-slot i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; }
.tc-armor-slot i.low { color: #e0715a; }
#tc-potions { position: absolute; bottom: 130px; right: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; align-items: flex-end; }
.tc-potion-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; }
.tc-potion-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--glow); flex: 0 0 auto; }
#tc-helditem { bottom: 128px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; }
#tc-sprint { top: 56px; left: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-sprint { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-sneak { top: 84px; left: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-sneak { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-helditem { left: 50%; right: auto; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-coords { left: auto; right: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-armor { right: auto; left: 18px; }
#tc-root.hud-right #tc-potions { right: auto; left: 18px; align-items: flex-start; }
#tc-fpsgraph { bottom: 18px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 6px; }
#tc-fpsgraph canvas { display: block; }
#tc-perfmon { top: 60px; left: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 108px; }
#tc-perfmon .tc-pm-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; }
#tc-perfmon .tc-pm-row span:last-child { color: var(--txt); }

/* ---------- HUD edit mode (drag to reposition) ---------- */
#tc-root.hud-editing .tc-hud-box, #tc-root.hud-editing #tc-keystrokes,
#tc-root.hud-editing #tc-cps, #tc-root.hud-editing #tc-fps, #tc-root.hud-editing #tc-potions {
  outline: 1px dashed var(--a-1); outline-offset: 3px; cursor: grab; pointer-events: auto; user-select: none;
}
#tc-root.hud-editing .tc-hidden { display: none !important; } /* keep disabled HUD elements hidden in edit mode */
#tc-root.hud-editing .tc-hud-drag-active { cursor: grabbing; outline-color: var(--a-hi); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow); }
/* dim the frozen game behind the HUD editor and swallow stray clicks (the in-game menu is open underneath to pause the world) */
#tc-root.hud-editing::before { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(6,8,16,0.55); pointer-events: auto; }
.tc-editbar { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 22px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 2147483001;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 9px 9px 9px 18px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); pointer-events: auto; }
.tc-editbar span { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); }
.tc-editbar button { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-editbar button:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }
.tc-editbar .tc-eb-reset { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--dim); border: 1px solid var(--bord); }
.tc-editbar .tc-eb-done { background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); color: var(--bg0); }

/* ---------- keybind manager ---------- */
.tc-kb-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 8px; }
.tc-kb-row .tc-lab { flex: 1; }
.tc-kb-warn { font-size: 11px; color: #e0715a; margin-top: 4px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #tc-root * { animation-duration: .001ms !important; transition-duration: .001ms !important; } }

/* ===== Themes tab (Frost + expandable theme system) ===== */
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] {
  --a-hi:#eaf7ff; --a-1:#bfe6ff; --a-2:#6fc3ec; --a-3:#2f6f9c;
  --txt:#eef7ff; --dim:#a9cadd;
  --panel:rgba(10,22,34,0.92); --panel2:rgba(16,34,52,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(150,210,245,0.26); --glow:rgba(130,200,255,0.42);
  --bg0:#07131f;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(18,44,66,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(150,210,245,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(130,200,255,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="tropical"] {
  --a-hi:#d9fff6; --a-1:#45e3c6; --a-2:#1fb6ba; --a-3:#0e6d78;
  --txt:#f3ecd6; --dim:#d8c38f;
  --panel:rgba(8,28,32,0.92); --panel2:rgba(12,40,46,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(120,230,215,0.26); --glow:rgba(70,220,200,0.42);
  --bg0:#05171a;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(14,52,56,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(120,230,215,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(70,220,200,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="terracotta"] {
  --a-hi:#ffcf9e; --a-1:#e8863a; --a-2:#c05f26; --a-3:#7a3d1d;
  --txt:#f6e6d4; --dim:#d8ad84;
  --panel:rgba(32,18,10,0.92); --panel2:rgba(46,26,14,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(232,150,80,0.26); --glow:rgba(226,130,60,0.42);
  --bg0:#1a0e06;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(60,32,16,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(232,150,80,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(226,130,60,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="forest"] {
  --a-hi:#d6f8c2; --a-1:#6fcb5b; --a-2:#3d9a3f; --a-3:#215a27;
  --txt:#eaf6dd; --dim:#aecb96;
  --panel:rgba(12,28,14,0.92); --panel2:rgba(16,40,20,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(140,220,120,0.26); --glow:rgba(110,210,90,0.42);
  --bg0:#07160a;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(20,52,24,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(140,220,120,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(110,210,90,0.30);
}
.tc-te-label { font: 600 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 7px; }
.tc-te-bgrow { margin-bottom: 13px; }
.tc-te-bgs { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tc-bgopt { width: 96px; height: 54px; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--bord); background-size: cover; background-position: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-bgopt:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-bgopt.sel { border-color: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--a-1); }
#tc-gui-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background-position: center; background-size: cover; background-repeat: no-repeat; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .45s var(--tc-ease); pointer-events: none; }
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] #tc-gui-img { opacity: 1; }
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] #tc-gui { background: rgba(6,16,28,0.34); }
#tc-gui-bg { z-index: 1; }
#tc-gui-panel { z-index: 2; }
.tc-titletext { -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-theme-hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); margin: 2px 2px 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tc-themes-head { margin: 0 2px 14px; }
.tc-themes-h1 { font: 700 15px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.tc-themes-sub { font: 500 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 3px; }
.tc-themes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(156px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.tc-theme { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; background: var(--panel2); aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; transition: transform var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-theme:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--a-2); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -14px var(--glow); }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-thumb { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-position: center; background-size: cover; }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-foot { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.80)); }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-name { font: 700 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-tag { margin-left: auto; font: 700 10px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-theme.selected { border-color: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--a-1), 0 10px 26px -14px var(--glow); }
.tc-theme.selected .tc-theme-tag { opacity: 1; }
.tc-title-editor { display: none; margin: 0 0 15px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel2); }
.tc-title-editor.open { display: block; animation: tcFade var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-head { font: 600 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); margin-bottom: 9px; }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-head b { color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-title-editor input { width: 100%; font: 500 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--bg0); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; outline: none; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tc-title-editor input:focus { border-color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-te-select { width: 100%; font: 500 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--bg0); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; outline: none; margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.tc-te-select:focus { border-color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tc-te-btns button { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-te-btns button:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); }
.tc-te-save { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-te-reset, .tc-te-cancel { color: var(--dim); background: transparent; }

    `;
  function ensureStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('tc-root-style')) return;
    try {
      var st = document.createElement('style');
      st.id = 'tc-root-style';
      st.textContent = TC_ROOT_CSS;
      (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(st);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  var TC_ROOT_HTML = `<div id="tc-root" data-theme="normal" aria-hidden="true">

    <div id="tc-fpsgraph" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden"><canvas id="tc-fpsgraph-cv" width="140" height="34"></canvas></div>
    <div id="tc-perfmon" class="tc-hud-box tc-hidden"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tc-editbar tc-hidden" id="tc-editbar">

    <button class="tc-eb-reset" id="tc-eb-reset">Reset Positions</button>
    <button class="tc-eb-done" id="tc-eb-done">Done</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ClickGUI (captures input only while open) -->
  <div id="tc-gui">

    <canvas id="tc-gui-bg"></canvas>

        <button class="tc-close" id="tc-close" aria-label="Close">✕</button>

      </div>

          <!-- hud -->
          <div class="tc-panel active" data-panel="hud" data-group="hud">
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Coordinates</b><i>Real X / Y / Z position</i></div><button class="tc-gear" data-gear="coordcfg" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="coords"><i></i></div></div>
              <div class="tc-cfg" data-cfg="coordcfg">

                  <div class="tc-seg" data-seg="coordPrecision">

            <div class="tc-mod">

            <div class="tc-mod">

            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Keystrokes</b><i>On-screen WASD + mouse</i></div><button class="tc-gear" data-gear="kscfg" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="keystrokes"><i></i></div></div>
              <div class="tc-cfg" data-cfg="kscfg">

              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>CPS Counter</b><i>Live clicks per second</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="cps"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>FPS Counter</b><i>Live framerate readout</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="fps"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Ping Display</b><i>Connection latency to the server</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="ping"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>FPS Graph</b><i>Recent framerate history</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="fpsGraph"><i></i></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tc-mod">
              <div class="tc-row"><div class="tc-lab"><b>Performance Monitor</b><i>FPS, frame time &amp; ping together</i></div><div class="tc-sw" data-mod="perfMonitor"><i></i></div></div>
